newsitem.title: USA: Novoste releases data on treatment.
newsitem.headline: Novoste releases data on treatment.

text.p: Novoste Corp said on Tuesday it has released preliminary data from the beta energy restenosis trial, which showed no adverse effects from the Beta-Cath system.

Sixteen of 23 patients enrolled in the study to treat restenosis, a renarrowing of a previously treated artery, have returned for follow up exams, with two requiring an additional procedure, Novoste said.

Restenosis is a limitation of using a coronary angioplasty to unblock blood vessels in the heart, Novoste said. About 25 to 45 percent of all patients are affected by Restenosis wihting six months of the original operation, Novoste said.
Novoste said its Beta-Cath system delivers localized radiation at the angioplasty site and is intended to inhibit vascular remodeling that causes restenosis.
